trap.label: modal e inversão
trap.wrong: Under no circumstances staff may share files.
trap.right: Under no circumstances may staff share files.
trap.why: O português não inverte após “em nenhuma circunstância”. Em inglês, a expressão negativa inicial puxa o modal antes do sujeito.

mcq.q: Under no circumstances ___ staff share files.

fix.wrong: Under no circumstances you should leave.
fix.right: Under no circumstances should you leave.

fix.wrong: Only when finished we can go.
fix.right: Only when finished can we go.

rewrite.prompt: Comece com Under no circumstances: “You must not open it.”
rewrite.answer: Under no circumstances must you open it.

rewrite.prompt: Comece com Only then: “He understood the problem then.”
rewrite.answer: Only then did he understand the problem.
